note: Amodu v2, from the user's own design (reference image) improved: rebuilt with Meshy image-to-3D in A-pose, auto-rigged, the v1 action set with a calmer idle, a face-down get-up for waking, running-jump candidates, and overhead carry/throw motions. Customisable: bags and gear are separate props attached to bones (assets/garden manifest group 'gear'); outfit colours come from Meshy retexture variants.
prompt: Stylized 3D game hero character: Amodu, a 12-year-old African boy with warm brown skin, a short neat buzz-cut, big friendly brown eyes and small stud earrings. He wears an orange polo shirt, a cord necklace with a small round green pendant, a brown leather belt with a round green-brass buckle and a small olive canvas pouch on the belt, khaki shorts with rolled hems, and olive-green sport sandals. Full body, standing in A-pose, facing forward. Stylized adventure-game look: chunky readable shapes, slightly large head and hands, clean silhouette, hand-painted look PBR textures. No backpack.
texture_prompt: Hand-painted stylized game textures: warm brown skin, orange polo shirt, khaki shorts, brown leather belt, olive sandals and pouch, green pendant. Vivid but natural colours.

ride_insect.prompt: A person sitting astride a large riding animal, leaning slightly forward, both hands holding reins in front, body swaying and bobbing gently with its steps.

lamp_walk.prompt: A person walking forward slowly while holding a lantern up high in the right hand to light the way, looking around carefully.

belly_crawl.prompt: A person crawling forward on their belly, pulling with elbows and pushing with knees, staying low to the ground, looping.

lift_overhead.prompt: A strong person squats, lifts a very heavy boulder from the ground and presses it high over their head with both arms, holding it steady.

carry_overhead_walk.prompt: A strong person walks forward steadily while holding a large heavy boulder high above their head with both arms extended straight up, hands gripping it, a looping walk cycle.

carry_overhead_idle.prompt: A strong person stands still holding a large heavy boulder high above their head with both arms extended straight up, breathing and swaying slightly.

throw_overhead.prompt: A strong person holding a heavy boulder above their head with both hands steps forward and hurls it far forward with both arms, then recovers to a relaxed standing pose.

spear_thrust.prompt: A person holding a long spear with both hands at waist height, point forward, steps forward and thrusts the spear straight ahead, then pulls it back to a ready guard.

spear_jab.prompt: A person in a ready stance holding a long spear with both hands, point forward, makes a quick short jab straight forward and pulls back.

spear_lunge.prompt: A person holding a long spear with both hands takes a big lunging step forward and drives the spear forward hard with the whole body, then recovers to a ready guard.

drink_cupped.prompt: A person standing still cups both hands together, scoops water from a big water drop in front of them at chest height, lifts the cupped hands to the mouth and drinks, then lowers the hands. The legs stay still and the head tilts a little down toward the hands.

kneel_drink.prompt: A person kneels down on one knee at the edge of a pond, scoops water from ground level with both cupped hands, lifts them to the mouth and drinks, then stands back up.

eat_bite.prompt: A person standing holds a piece of bread in both hands in front of the chest, takes two big bites and chews, looking pleased. The legs stay still.

web_struggle.prompt: A person stuck in a sticky spider web with arms and feet caught struggles hard on the spot: yanks the arms back and forth, twists the torso from side to side and strains to pull a leg free, without moving from the spot.

web_break_free.prompt: A person caught in sticky threads makes one last powerful pull with the whole body, tears free and stumbles two steps forward, then catches their balance.

knife_cut.prompt: A person crouches low and saws back and forth at a thick plant stem with a short knife in the right hand, the left hand holding the stem, then pulls the cut piece away.

craft.prompt: A person kneels on one knee and works with both hands on something small on the ground in front of them, tying and binding a cord tightly around it, then lifts it up to look at it.

swim_surface.prompt: A person swimming breaststroke at the surface of the water with the head held up above the water looking forward: arms sweep out and back together, the legs do a frog kick, body angled slightly.

dive_down.prompt: A person treading water upright bends forward at the waist and dives head first down under the water, arms reaching forward and down, legs kicking up behind.

swim_underwater.prompt: A person swimming underwater with the body horizontal and the head forward in line with the body, arms sweeping wide breaststroke pulls and the legs doing a frog kick, gliding forward.

underwater_idle.prompt: A person floating underwater holding their breath, body upright and relaxed, gently sculling with the hands and slowly kicking the legs to hold position.

knife_slash.prompt: A person in a low fighting crouch holding a short knife in the right hand makes a fast diagonal slash from high right to low left, then returns to guard.

knife_stab.prompt: A person holding a short knife in the right hand steps forward and makes a quick straight stab at chest height, then pulls back into a ready crouch.

knife_backhand.prompt: A person holding a short knife in the right hand makes a quick backhand slash from left to right across the body with a small step, then returns to guard.

hammer_side_swing.prompt: A strong person holding a heavy stone hammer with both hands swings it horizontally from right to left in a wide powerful arc at waist height, stepping into the swing.
